regions.merged_text: Many thanks for your kind favor just noted. I have given my enrollment over to the Poor Souls in Purgatory - especially for those of Kenneth's rela- tives - that they help to obtain the necessary peace for him to be consciencously earnest. In the mean time, have as many as possible "storm Heaven by daily - or more frequent - Communion". Hop- ing to get better word the next time and praying for God's guidance, I beg to remain
